pages.text: MathMod exposes an optional KubeJS bridge through Java.loadClass.$(br2)Use it from kubejs/startup_scripts to register materials, tune rune budgets, add material requirements, configure anchor presets, and enable or disable runes.

pages.title: Safety
pages.text: KubeJS changes definitions, not runtime spell logic. executorKey must refer to Java-side behavior implemented by MathMod. This keeps spell execution server-safe and predictable.

pages.title: Anchor Presets
pages.text: Pack scripts can call setAnchorSacrifice(selector, count, radius), setOfferingSparkDrop(item, count), and setWardingPulse(radius, strength).$(br2)Selectors accept exact items, tags, or comma-separated mixes.

pages.title: Default Materials
pages.text: MathMod ships defaults for vanilla items plus common modpack tags: tin, bronze, steel, osmium, arcane essence/source, and allthemodium.$(br2)Use setMaterialTranslationKey(id, key) to give a tagged material a localized catalog name. Its stable id and full selector remain in the hover details.

pages.title: Manuscripts
pages.text: The manuscript API is also declarative. In a startup script, register a tradition, then register each manuscript with a schema version, title, pages, icon, and rarity.$(br2)The complete sample is in docs/examples/kubejs/mathmod_manuscripts.js. It does not execute spells, grant knowledge, change loot, or access players and worlds.

pages.title: Stable Names
pages.text: Use namespaced ids such as example:constant_fields. A manuscript may point to a theorem or Patchouli entry, but the reader record remains data only.$(br2)Aliases migrate an old id to a new id: MathMod.manuscriptAlias(1, 'example:old_constant_fields', 'example:constant_fields'). Duplicate ids and invalid references are rejected during reload.
